name: Analog / IO interface
description: Generic analog and digital sensor-interface transmitters — 4-20 mA loops, 0-10 V inputs, potentiometers, raw ADC, and dry-contact / pulse counters. The physical quantity is defined by the attached probe; this category normalizes the raw interface reading.
notes: analog.current is mA, analog.voltage is V, analog.ratio is %, analog.raw is ADC counts; pulse.count/total are counts. A device whose reading has a known physical unit (temperature, pressure, level, …) belongs in that specific category instead.
